plain.text: "The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not be in want." He makes me lie down in green pastures and leads me beside quiet waters. He restores my soul. He guides me along the right paths for the sake of his name.
"Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me; your rod and your staff, they comfort me."

"You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows." "Surely goodness and loving devotion will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever."

summary.bigIdea: The LORD cares for his people like a good shepherd: providing, guiding, staying close in the darkest valley, and welcoming them home.
points: "The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not be in want."
Even in the darkest valley, "you are with me".
God's goodness and love follow us all our lives, and we will dwell in his house forever.
summary.reflection: Which line of this psalm do you most need today? Try reading it slowly, adding your own name.
